_comment: Survival AutoMedic: your own consumables from other mods. Copy this file to items-user.json in this folder and add your items. The example file itself is never read.
One item per line: "Plugin.esp|ID|key=number|flag|...". ID is the item's FormID as xEdit shows it: 0F12, 00000F12, 06000F12 or FE001F12 (ESL) all work.
Papyrus cannot read an item's effects, so you write the numbers (look them up in xEdit, or on the mod page):
heal=110     heals 110 HP in total
healpct=30   heals 30% of max HP (like a stimpak)
sec=10       over 10 seconds (leave it out for instant)
rads=15      adds 15 rads
radsout=100  removes 100 rads
ap=50        restores 50 AP
risk=7       disease risk in % (only if the mod's own guess is wrong)
Flags, for what the item does but the mod cannot see:
disease      cures diseases        addiction  cures addictions
buff         gives a timed buff    addictive  can cause an addiction
Hunger, thirst, food/drink/chem/alcohol and the disease risk are read from the item's keywords - no need to write them.
An entry for an item that the mod already knows (vanilla, DLC, UFO4P) replaces its numbers - useful if another mod changed that item.
Up to 128 items. Reload in MCM: Items - Reload your items. With the log on (Detailed) every entry is logged with what the mod understood from it.
Examples (the plugins are made up):
"MyFoodMod.esp|000F12|heal=110|sec=10|rads=15",
"Some Chems Mod.esp|0008A4|healpct=30|sec=5",
"CleanWater.esl|FE001801|radsout=20",
"Doctor Mod.esp|000812|disease",
